title: More than one frequent candidate
hook: A small table must decide what to forget when a new item arrives.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Uniform hash/draw assumptions; probability and weighted ranks as stated.
doesNotKnow: Maintain k-1 cancellation counters and bound which items can exceed frequency n/k.

misconception: The single majority-vote survivor finds every item above a smaller frequency threshold.
objective: Maintain k-1 cancellation counters and bound which items can exceed frequency n/k.

claims.text: A full-table miss cancels one occurrence from every stored candidate and the arriving item. These survivors are candidates, not certified heavy hitters; a second counting pass is needed to confirm a threshold.
